records.source: ItemDelivery/Robin's Request/Robin wrote to you asking for some hardwood./Bring Robin 10 pieces of Hardwood./Robin (O)709 10/-1/500/-1/true/Oh, you brought it! I know I can always count on you, @.$h#$b#Mmhmm... This wood is perfect. It's exactly what I need. Thanks!
records.translation: ItemDelivery/羅賓的請求/羅賓寫信請你提供一些硬木。/帶 10 塊硬木給羅賓。/Robin (O)709 10/-1/500/-1/true/喔，你帶來了！我就知道永遠可以靠你，@。$h#$b#嗯哼……這些木材很完美。正是我需要的。謝謝！

records.source: ItemDelivery/Fish Stew/Gus wants to make fish stew, but he needs an albacore./Bring Gus an Albacore./Gus (O)705/-1/400/-1/true/*sniff*...*sniff*... What's that? Something smells like albacore!#$b#Aha! You brought it! Thanks a million!
records.translation: ItemDelivery/燉魚/格斯想做燉魚，但他需要一條長鰭鮪魚。/帶一條長鰭鮪魚給格斯。/Gus (O)705/-1/400/-1/true/*嗅*……*嗅*……那是什麼？有東西聞起來像長鰭鮪魚！#$b#啊哈！你帶來了！太感謝了！

records.source: ItemDelivery/Fresh Fruit/Emily wants a taste of spring. She's asking for a fresh apricot./Bring Emily an Apricot./Emily (O)634/-1/600/-1/true/Oh... You followed through! Thanks, this looks delicious!$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/新鮮水果/艾蜜莉想品嘗春季的滋味。她需要一顆新鮮杏桃。/帶一顆杏桃給艾蜜莉。/Emily (O)634/-1/600/-1/true/喔……你真的帶來了！謝謝，看起來好美味！$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Granny's Gift/Evelyn wants to surprise her husband with a gift./Bring Evelyn a Leek./Evelyn (O)20/-1/500/-1/true/Oh, thank you, dear. This leek looks delicious. George will be so happy.#$b#He loves when I make eggs with leeks for breakfast.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/奶奶的禮物/伊芙琳想用一份禮物給丈夫驚喜。/帶一根韭蔥給伊芙琳。/Evelyn (O)20/-1/500/-1/true/喔，謝謝你，親愛的。這根韭蔥看起來很美味。喬治一定會很開心。#$b#他最喜歡我在早餐做韭蔥炒蛋。

records.source: ItemDelivery/Pierre's Notice/Pierre will pay "top coin" to whoever brings him a plate of sashimi. Apparently he's really craving the stuff./Bring Pierre some Sashimi./Pierre (O)227/-1/1000/-1/true/It's about time! I was starting to get the shakes, I wanted this fish so bad. *munch*... Mmm, now that's good.#$b#Thanks, @.$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/皮埃爾的公告/皮埃爾願意付「最高價」給任何帶一盤生魚片給他的人。看來他真的非常想吃。/帶一些生魚片給皮埃爾。/Pierre (O)227/-1/1000/-1/true/總算來了！我太想吃這份魚，等得都開始發抖了。*咀嚼*……嗯，這才叫美味。#$b#謝謝，@。$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Aquatic Research/Demetrius is studying the toxin levels of the local pufferfish. He'd like you to bring him one./Bring Demetrius a Pufferfish./Demetrius (O)128/-1/1000/-1/true/There you are. The specimen looks perfect. I'm going to get it on ice straight away. Thanks, @!
records.translation: ItemDelivery/水生研究/德米特里厄斯正在研究當地河豚的毒素含量。他希望你帶一條給他。/帶一條河豚給德米特里厄斯。/Demetrius (O)128/-1/1000/-1/true/你來了。這份標本看起來很完美。我要立刻用冰保存。謝謝，@！

records.source: ItemDelivery/A Soldier's Star/Kent wants to give his wife a starfruit for their anniversary./Bring Kent a Starfruit./Kent (O)268/-1/500/-1/true/Hey. Shhh... Don't let Jodi see.#$b#Ah, this looks juicy. She'll love it. Thank you so much.$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/士兵之星/肯特想在結婚紀念日送一顆楊桃給妻子。/帶一顆楊桃給肯特。/Kent (O)268/-1/500/-1/true/嘿。噓……別讓喬迪看到。#$b#啊，看起來很多汁。她會喜歡的。非常感謝。$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Mayor's Need/Mayor Lewis wants truffle oil. He won't explain what it's for. Maybe it's none of your business./Bring Lewis a bottle of Truffle Oil./Lewis (O)432/-1/750/-1/true/You got the oil? Let me see...#$b#It's high quality... very slick. Great. Thank you.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/鎮長的需求/路易斯鎮長想要松露油。他不肯解釋用途。也許這不關你的事。/帶一瓶松露油給路易斯鎮長。/Lewis (O)432/-1/750/-1/true/你拿到油了？讓我看看……#$b#品質很高……非常滑潤。很好。謝謝。

records.source: ItemDelivery/Wanted: Lobster/Gus put out a notice requesting a fresh lobster./Bring Gus a Lobster./Gus (O)715/-1/800/-1/true/Something smells like fresh lobster. Oh, that's good.$h#$b#Take care, friend.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/徵求：龍蝦/格斯張貼公告，徵求一隻新鮮龍蝦。/帶一隻龍蝦給格斯。/Gus (O)715/-1/800/-1/true/有東西聞起來像新鮮龍蝦。喔，真不錯。$h#$b#保重，朋友。

records.source: ItemDelivery/Pam Needs Juice/Pam's TV Remote is dead. She's having a tough time going back and forth between the couch and the TV dial./Bring Pam a Battery Pack./Pam (O)787/-1/400/-1/true/Hey, you pulled through with the battery pack! Thanks, kid... You're a life-saver!$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/潘姆需要電力/潘姆的電視遙控器沒電了。她受不了一直在沙發和電視頻道旋鈕之間來回走動。/帶一組電池組給潘姆。/Pam (O)787/-1/400/-1/true/嘿，你真的帶了電池組來！謝了，孩子……你救了我一命！$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Staff Of Power/The Wizard is creating a staff of phenomenal power. Who knows what it's for. He needs an iridium bar to finish it./Bring Wizard an Iridium Bar./Wizard (O)337/-1/5000/-1/true/Ah, precious iridium. You've done well, @. You have my gratitude. Now, leave.
records.translation: ItemDelivery/力量法杖/法師正在製作一根力量驚人的法杖。沒人知道有什麼用途。他需要一根銥錠才能完成。/帶一根銥錠給法師。/Wizard (O)337/-1/5000/-1/true/啊，珍貴的銥。你做得很好，@。你贏得了我的謝意。現在離開吧。

records.source: ItemDelivery/Catch a Lingcod/Willy is challenging you to catch a Lingcod./Bring Willy a Lingcod./Willy (O)707/-1/550/-1/true/Hey, that's a real lunker! You've certainly got the angler's blood in you.$h
records.translation: ItemDelivery/捕捉蛇鱈/威利向你發出挑戰，要你捕捉一條蛇鱈。/帶一條蛇鱈給威利。/Willy (O)707/-1/550/-1/true/嘿，這可是真正的大傢伙！你體內肯定流著釣手的血。$h

records.source: ItemDelivery/Exotic Spirits/Gus wants to make a Coco-no-no, but he's missing the main ingredient./Bring Gus a Coconut./Gus (O)88/-1/600/-1/true/Coconut! Now there's a soothing sight for my winter eyes.$h#$b#It's going to be perfect for my coco-no-no. Thanks!
records.translation: ItemDelivery/異國烈酒/格斯想做一杯椰椰不樂，但缺少主要材料。/帶一顆椰子給格斯。/Gus (O)88/-1/600/-1/true/椰子！在冬季看到這個真令人舒心。$h#$b#用來做我的椰椰不樂一定很完美。謝謝！

records.source: ItemDelivery/Errand for your Wife/Your wife asked you to bring her 200 pieces of fiber for a secret project./Bring Emily 200 fiber./Emily (O)771 200/-1/0/-1/false/Oh, this looks perfect... and it's sustainably sourced, too! Thanks so much, @.$h#$b#Now, I've got my work cut out for me. It'll be a few more days before it's ready...
records.translation: ItemDelivery/替妻子跑腿/你的妻子請你帶 200 份纖維給她，用在一項祕密計畫。/帶 200 份纖維給艾蜜莉。/Emily (O)771 200/-1/0/-1/false/喔，這看起來很完美……而且來源也符合永續原則！非常感謝，@。$h#$b#現在我有得忙了。還要再過幾天才能完成……

records.source: Basic/Haley's Cake-Walk/Your wife is organizing a charity cake-walk in the town square. She asked you to bring a chocolate cake./Enter Town on a sunny morning with a chocolate cake./-1/-1/0/-1/true
records.translation: Basic/海莉的蛋糕遊戲/你的妻子正在鎮上廣場舉辦慈善蛋糕遊戲。她請你帶一個巧克力蛋糕。/晴朗的早晨帶著巧克力蛋糕進入城鎮。/-1/-1/0/-1/true

records.source: SecretLostItem/.../.../.../Abigail (O)191 100 129/-1/0/-1/false/That necklace! Where did you find it?$7#$b#Well, thanks for bringing it to me, @. My mom will never know...$h
records.translation: SecretLostItem/.../.../.../Abigail (O)191 100 129/-1/0/-1/false/那條項鍊！你在哪裡找到的？$7#$b#嗯，謝謝你把它帶給我，@。我媽永遠不會知道……$h

records.source: SecretLostItem/.../.../.../Caroline (O)191 50 128/-1/0/-1/false/What's this? My old necklace?$s#$b#That's strange, I didn't even notice it was missing... Well, thanks for bringing it back, @.$h
records.translation: SecretLostItem/.../.../.../Caroline (O)191 50 128/-1/0/-1/false/這是什麼？我的舊項鍊？$s#$b#真奇怪，我甚至沒注意到它不見了……嗯，謝謝你把它帶回來，@。$h

records.source: Basic/The Pirate's Wife/An old lady living on Ginger Island is asking you to find a keepsake of her husband's. She gave you an old photograph of a soldier that washed up on shore, hoping it would help in some way./Find a keepsake that belonged to Birdie's husband./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/海盜的妻子/住在薑島的老婦人請你尋找丈夫留下的紀念物。她給了你一張沖上岸的士兵舊照片，希望能以某種方式提供幫助。/找到一件屬於伯蒂丈夫的紀念物。/-1/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: Fishing/Willy's Challenge/Willy has challenged you to catch 3 Sandfish./Catch 3 Sandfish./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Fishing/威利的挑戰/威利向你發出挑戰，要你捕捉 3 條沙魚。/捕捉 3 條沙魚。/-1/-1/0/-1/false

records.source: ItemHarvest/Getting Started/If you want to become a farmer, you have to start with the basics. Feed your chickens each day by letting them eat grass outside, or by placing hay into their troughs. Once they are mature, harvest an egg!/Harvest an egg from your chickens./-5/h8 133/100/-1/true
records.translation: ItemHarvest/開始飼養/想成為農夫，就得從基礎做起。每天讓雞到戶外吃草，或把乾草放進飼料槽餵食。牠們成年後，收成一顆雞蛋！/從你的雞收成一顆雞蛋。/-5/h8 133/100/-1/true

records.source: Building/Feeding Animals/Robin, the local carpenter, lives north of town. In exchange for raw materials and money, she'll construct new buildings on your farm. If you build a silo, you can start harvesting your own grass with the scythe, and store it to feed your animals./Build a Silo./Silo/-1/100/-1/true
records.translation: Building/餵養動物/當地木匠羅賓住在城鎮北方。只要提供原料和金錢，她就會在你的農場建造新建築。建造筒倉後，就能用鐮刀收割自己的青草並儲存起來，用來餵養動物。/建造一座筒倉。/Silo/-1/100/-1/true

records.source: Basic/The Giant Stump/The big tree to the south of my farm blew down. With 100 hardwood, I could turn the stump into something interesting.../Fix up the giant stump./-1/-1/0/-1/false
records.translation: Basic/巨大樹樁/我農場南方的大樹被風吹倒了。只要有 100 塊硬木，就能把樹樁改造成有趣的東西……/修復巨大樹樁。/-1/-1/0/-1/false
